title: [GMCP 203.040.M] Mastery: OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, and diagnostics
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-040-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP emits bounded OpenTelemetry-compatible traces, metrics and structured logs across host, gateway, transport, server and callback boundaries, propagating standard trace context from MCP metadata. RED/USE, queue, cache, policy, consent, task and lifecycle signals have stable schemas and cardinality budgets; payload redaction is structural; diagnostics explain failures locally and export only under explicit policy. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
